scope: Typed native body invocation preserves callback-local error handling and explicit publication failure semantics

before.observed: Native Store and directly materialized policy let the observer catch its native failure; compiled typed publisher returned that failure and omitted the caught event.

checks.note: All six adjacent targets passed, including mapped/rebuilt native-boundary images. The final publication target used an earlier classifier that compared Symbol display text including # against plain text; it failed. The final classifier compares Symbol identity, and the separate final publication run above passes.

contract_review.contract: Explicit native argument/result adaptation must not suppress ordinary error handling inside an entered callback; unhandled native failures keep their exact identities and callbacks are not replayed.
contract_review.before: validate signature -> set ambient preserve flag -> convert inputs -> invoke body/callbacks -> convert result -> restore flag -> report native failure or answer
contract_review.after: validate signature -> convert inputs -> invoke body/callbacks -> convert result -> report native failure or answer
contract_review.production_change: Remove two lines that implicitly changed the shared Execution failure policy during typed-body invocation.
contract_review.ownership: Execution retains native conversion and Machine error handling; callbacks use only Id messages. No private cross-module interface is added.

retained_checks: Nine scenarios across native Store, directly materialized synchronous policy and explicit compiled native policy
Authorization failure and veto precede dictionary mutation
Notification failure occurs after mutation without rollback or callback replay
Ordinary Error notification results are void; Error authorization results veto
Callback-local caught and converted native errors retain their handling
Exact native failure identity and details 17/99
Ordinary source caller handles native publication failure at its own boundary
Subsequent callbacks still handle their errors

superseded_experiments.authority: docs/design/publication-failure-boundary.md#subsequent-design-clarification and docs/design/method-publication-owner.md record the user rejection of dual language error conventions and backwards-compatibility requirements for the old experiment.
superseded_experiments.removed_from_active_gate: Historical negative comparisons among whole/local ambient preservation and deferred request adapter variants; these rejected experimental paths are not restored as a new publication protocol.
superseded_experiments.observation: The initial mechanical port found local preservation now yields an ordinary outer result instead of the old experimental native escape. That historical observation was not used to change production semantics.
